summary: HTTP/HTTPS storage backend using httpx. Monolithic class (not mixin-composed). Implements Read, Write, Metadata protocols. read via GET, write via PUT, metadata via HEAD. Error mapping: 404->PathNotFoundError, 401/403->AuthenticationError. Lazy client initialisation.
lifecycle_notes: Added in Phase 5 as newest backend — does not implement List, Delete, Copy, or Directory protocols
risks: read_to_stream wraps response.content in BytesIO (not true streaming)
No List/Delete/Copy/Directory support — limited protocol coverage

open_questions.question: Should List protocol be added via HTML directory index parsing?
open_questions.evidence: HTTP backend only implements 3 of 8 protocols
